distribution: Mengga, Luxi, Yunnan, 1380 m above sea level.
soldier: Head brown; the base of the mandibles yellowish brown, from the middle to the apical teeth reddish brown; labrum and antennae pale yellow; pronotum concolorous with the head, legs pale yellow. Head densely covered with fine hairs and sparsely with long hairs, the postmentum with short hairs and long hairs intermixed in its anterior part, thorax and abdomen with many long hairs in addition to short ones. Medium-sized; head length slightly greater than the width, the sides nearly parallel, widest about posteriorly, highest at the middle, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight; the dorsal longitudinal suture of the head extending forwards from the middle of the posterior margin to one third of the head length. Labrum ligulate. Mandibles very stout, flattened, broad and swollen at the base, the outer margin with distinct undulate prominences; left mandible with a blunt marginal tooth near the middle of the inner margin, right mandible with a triangular marginal tooth at the middle of the inner margin, its tip directed obliquely inwards. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Postmentum narrow and elongate, narrowest in the posterior half. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe standing vertically above the posterior lobe, the anterior margin of the anterior lobe narrowly rounded, the posterior margin of the posterior lobe slightly concave in the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Sinitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Indotermes.
